activity.notes: Maximilian was elected King of the Romans in 1486, initially ruling alongside his father Frederick III. After Frederick's death on 19 August 1493 he became sole Roman-German king. ATLAS preserves this pre-imperial title phase separately from his emperor-elect title adopted in 1508.

sources.title: Deutschlandmuseum — Maximilian I becomes sole Roman-German king
sources.citation_text: The museum notes Maximilian's earlier co-kingship and his becoming sole Roman-German king on 19 August 1493.

sources.title: Maximilian I, Holy Roman Emperor — office chronology
sources.citation_text: The office chronology records his election as King of the Romans in 1486 and adoption of the imperial title on 4 February 1508.
